label: RadarCount
description: Counts the vehicles that pass you using your ANT+ rear radar and shows their speed and distance in data fields styled like the Karoo's own. Writes the same developer fields to the ride FIT file as the Garmin MyBikeTraffic app, so rides upload to mybiketraffic.com. No alerts, no sounds, no network access. Open source, MIT licensed.
releaseNotes:
* Optional: keep a passed car's speed on screen for 3, 5 or 10 s, in grey and marked PASSED
* A settings card per field with a live preview, and a header on/off switch for every field
* Fields drawn to the pixel: digits no longer cut off on the Karoo 2, bigger mph speeds
* One-line field names, new speed and distance icons, Karoo-style settings screens
* Vehicle Speed shows absolute (road) speed by default; relative speed is labelled VEHICLE REL SPEED in the header
* Sideloaded installs now get updates from the extension store
